capabilities: Paste a URL as a titled link, inline mention, or link card via a paste menu
Convert an existing link into a mention or card with commands
Download and save favicons and thumbnails into the vault
Configure the folder where images are stored
Style mentions and cards via documented CSS selectors and a variable
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README says it may not yet be listed in the community plugin browse. The plugin fetches the pasted page's title, description, image and favicon from its own site, but states it sends nothing from the vault and has no telemetry. It warns to disable paste handling in other URL-rewriting plugins to avoid double handling.
problem: Pasting a URL into a note gives only a bare or plain link, with no easy way to get richer link representations that still remain valid Markdown.

relations.evidence: Plugins that also rewrite pasted URLs, such as Auto Link Title, handle the same paste event.

summary: Link paste formatter that lets you paste a URL as a titled link, an inline mention, or a link card, all stored as plain Markdown.
